Package zephyr.wallet.model

Class ZephyrWalletListener

java.lang.Object
zephyr.wallet.model.ZephyrWalletListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
ZephyrWalletListenerI
public class ZephyrWalletListener extends Object implements ZephyrWalletListenerI
Default wallet listener which takes no action on notifications.

    • onBalancesChanged

      @Deprecated public final void onBalancesChanged(BigInteger newBalance, BigInteger newUnlockedBalance)
      Deprecated.
      override onBalancesChanged(BigInteger, BigInteger, String) instead
      Not called by zephyr-java: balances change per asset. Kept final so that a listener ported from monero-java fails to compile here instead of never being notified.
      Parameters:
      newBalance - is not used
      newUnlockedBalance - is not used

      public void onOutputReceived(ZephyrOutputWallet output)
      The unconfirmed notification carries no asset type (the core does not pass it for pool outputs); the confirmed and unlocked notifications do. Use onBalancesChanged or getTxs() for the asset of an unconfirmed output.

      Parameters:
